inv.desc_en:
Very important: please watch the videos and read the description carefully!

Only cash payments or clients with 50% savings of the property value.

Iniciativas Futuro, in collaboration with AID, presents a commercial space converted into 2 independent dwellings of 65m2 each.

It is located a five-minute walk from the Simancas metro station, surrounded by parks, schools, several bus stops, etc.

The usage remains commercial, which is why it is priced this way. It is a single registered property.

Each dwelling consists of 3 bedrooms, a living room, a kitchen, and a bathroom.

At "Iniciativas Futuro, " we manage your mortgage with financing of up to 90% of the purchase price, with the best market conditions. Consult us without obligation.

The client is informed that notary fees, registry fees, property transfer tax (I. T. P. ), financial expenses, and other expenses inherent to the sale are not included in the price.

Office hours: Monday to Friday from 10:00 to 14:00 and from 17:00 to 20:00, and Saturday by appointment.
